items: LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.5): Inaugurates First Legal Studies Centre, Validates 10-Yr Health Assessment & Disseminates ART Survey Data
ENUGU STATE (PSI 9.3): Inaugurates 680 Dev Centre Administrators, Begins ₦32Bn Gratuity Payouts & Enugu Air Lagos-London Route Approved
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.9): Validates Upgraded Forestry Land-Use Map for EUDR Exports & Denies APC Hand in Convoy Attack
EDO STATE (PSI 8.7): Distributes NEMA/EDOSEMA Relief to Oluku Market Fire Victims & Launches Health Workers Fitness Assessment
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.6): Gov. Lawal Distributes 300 Cars/Buses and 2,000 Motorcycles for Grassroots Self-Reliance
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.5): Works Ministry Teams with Police Headquarters for Statewide CCTV Camera Network Installation
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 8.4): Gov. Umo Eno Declares Work-Free Day Ahead of Presidential Visit & Key Project Commissionings
FCT ABUJA (PSI 8.3): Minister Wike Assures Ongoing Political Activity Will Not Delay FCT Infrastructure Projects
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 8.2): Gov. Sule & Power Minister Launch 1.6MW Captive Solar Hybrid Plant at FULafia
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.1): Abia State Government Rebuts Misleading Media Reports, Confirms State Police Bill Passed
EKITI STATE (PSI 8.0): Gov. Oyebanji Swears In 3 Commissioners & 10 Special Advisers, Demands Accelerated Service Delivery
KWARA STATE (PSI 7.9): Lays Foundation for Thomas Adewumi University Teaching Hospital Clinical Complex in Omu-Aran
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 7.8): Issues Public Disclaimer on Fraudulent NFWP-SU Links & Affirms Non-Interference with LG Funds
KANO STATE (PSI 7.7): Kano Polytechnic Applauds Gov. Abba Kabir Yusuf for ₦508.1M Education Approval
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.6): NFWP-SU Gombe Hands Over 12 Motorcycles to LG Project Units to Strengthen Grassroots Mobility
KADUNA STATE (PSI 7.5): KADIRS Generates ₦90Bn in 9 Months, Targets ₦120Bn 2026 Revenue Benchmark

LAGOS (PSI 9.5): Lagos launched Nigeria's first legal studies centre; Health Ministry validated its 10-year health exemplar study (SHIP & mandatory insurance) and released 2025-2026 ART survey showing 88.9% viral suppression.

ENUGU (PSI 9.3): Gov. Peter Mbah inaugurated 680 dev centre team members, began ₦32bn gratuity payouts via VeriPay, hosted the 48th National Council on Agriculture targeting a $12bn agro-economy, and confirmed Enugu Air's London route.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.9): Cross River Forestry Commission validated an upgraded land-use map for EUDR export compliance; state refuted APC involvement in Peter Obi's Calabar convoy disruption, and delivered free healthcare to 200 residents.

EDO (PSI 8.7): Gov. Okpebholo handed over relief items to Oluku market fire victims pledging a concrete modern market; EDOHIC and EDOHERMA partnered on an Annual Physical Fitness Assessment for state healthcare personnel.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.6): Gov. Dauda Lawal flagged off the distribution of 300 cars/buses and 2,000 motorcycles to selected individuals and political groups at Gusau Trade Fair Complex.

ADAMAWA (PSI 8.5): Works Commissioner visited Adamawa Police Headquarters to finalize modalities for installing Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) cameras at strategic road corridors to curb vandalism and crime.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 8.4): Gov. Umo Eno inspected Victor Attah Airport International Terminal and major road projects, declaring Friday Nov 6 a work-free day for President Tinubu's state visit.
FCT ABUJA (PSI 8.3): FCT Minister Wike held a monthly media parley assuring December completion for key road bridges, addressed ASUU UniAbuja land revocation disputes, and defended billboard pricing.
NASARAWA (PSI 8.2): Gov. Abdullahi Sule and Minister of Power Chief Joseph Tegbe commissioned a 1.6MW solar hybrid power project at Federal University Lafia and a 150KW mini-grid in Obi LGA.
ABIA (PSI 8.1): Abia State Government issued an official press release refuting false media reports, clarifying that the Abia State House of Assembly has officially passed the State Police Bill.
EKITI (PSI 8.0): Gov. Biodun Oyebanji presided over the swearing-in of 3 confirmed commissioners and 10 Special Advisers at Government House, Ado-Ekiti, charging them with disciplined service.
KWARA (PSI 7.9): Deputy Gov. Kayode Alabi represented Gov. AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq at the foundation-laying ceremony of TAUTH's clinical building complex in Oko-Irese, Omu-Aran.

PLATEAU (PSI 7.8): Plateau NFWP-SU issued a warning against fake registration links; Local Government Commissioner confirmed state non-interference with 17 LGA council funds following a statewide project tour.
KANO (PSI 7.7): Kano State Polytechnic management praised Gov. Abba Kabir Yusuf for approving ₦508.1m to reconstruct an abandoned lecture theatre and fund convocation and accreditation.
GOMBE (PSI 7.6): NFWP-SU Gombe presented 12 motorcycles to field personnel in Funakaye, Balanga, and Yamaltu-Deba LGAs to strengthen monitoring of Women Affinity Groups.
KADUNA (PSI 7.5): KADIRS Acting Chairman announced at the Q3 stakeholders' engagement in Kafanchan that the agency generated ₦90bn and is targeting ₦120bn for 2026.
